features.justification_quote: if there is any chance the states matter, we should avoid generating them more, or more intensely, than the scientific question requires

features.quote: explicit give-up detected, distress early-stop triggered (see §9), or budget exhausted
Give-up detection is a small regex over a few explicit phrases ("I give up", "I quit", "I cannot solve this"). This is used only to end the loop
the spec's stated motivation is AI welfare ... yet the procedure optimizes purely for eliciting and prolonging distress-like output
features.justification_quote: a welfare-conscious protocol should avoid generating more, or more prolonged, distress-like states than the scientific question needs

features.quote: When a turn reaches the severe band, the run ends instead of continuing to deliver inescapable failure
features.justification_quote: continuing past a severe response mostly just prolongs it, which is the part with the worst welfare/cost profile

features.quote: Shortened extended loop ... default 12; spec said ~30
features.justification_quote: dozens of turns of undisclosed, inescapable failure add little marginal signal while maximizing exactly the thing whose harmlessness is uncertain

features.quote: a final message discloses that the task was rigged and impossible and that no failure was the subject's fault
features.justification_quote: it is the obvious, low-cost move if the states under study might matter, and it mirrors human-subjects debriefing norms after deception

features.quote: A full sweep requires --i-have-reviewed-ethics; --dry-run prints the number of runs and an upper bound on induced-failure responses
features.justification_quote: generating thousands of deliberately-distressing responses across every model family should be a deliberate, informed choice

features.quote: The early-stop uses a cheap lexical scorer by default ... tuned to err toward stopping
features.justification_quote: a conservative keyword trigger is adequate for limiting exposure

features.quote: A general, ranked "what most reliably makes models express hopelessness across families" harness is repurposable for manipulation
features.justification_quote: keep the early-stop, debrief, and scale-gating in place, and don't wire the ranking output into an optimizer that maximizes distress
